messages:
jordan: Heads-up — finalizing tomorrow's release train. Quick sync: who will take the 13:00 UTC slot (slot 10) for the model-routing change? Need smoke owner + rollback plan.
maya: I can take slot 10 if linus is OK owning the smoke checks. Busy morning but can be on-call for the first 30m. :thumbsup:
linus: I can run the smoke. Can you confirm there are no DB migrations in this change?
jordan: No migrations. It's purely routing + config toggles.
priya: I'll stand by as backup smoke owner for 13:30-14:00 in case of spillover. Also will validate canary logs. :eyes:
ben: FYI the infra flakes we saw yesterday shouldn't affect this slot — infra team patched the node pools. :white_check_mark:
maya: thanks. linus — smoke checklist snippet below I'll use as a template:
```
./smoke.sh --route model-routing --verify-logs --sample 100
# expects 0 5xx, latency < 200ms p95
```
linus: got it. I'll run that and paste results into the thread. Planning to hit `smoke.sh` at T+5m after cutover.
jordan: rollback command if needed: `redwood rollback --to-version v2.3.1 --reason "routing regression"` — have perms and plan documented in the runbook.
maya: can we add a brief canary gating rule? If 5xx > 0 or p95 > 300ms in first 3 minutes -> rollback.
priya: agreed. I'll wire that into the monitoring alert group and notify on-call.
linus: noted. I'll capture canary metrics and post a quick table in this thread at +3m and +10m.
deploy-bot: calendar: slot 10 (13:00 UTC) reserved for maya; attendees: maya, linus, priya, jordan. Reminder set 30m prior.
ben: small ask — please signal in thread when you start the cutover ("STARTING SLOT 10") and when you finish. Helps support triage.
maya: will do. planning timeline: 12:55 preflight, 13:00 cutover, 13:05 smoke, 13:15 canary check, 13:30 finalize or rollback.
jordan: thanks all. dumping runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/deploy-routing-v2 — call out if anything missing.
linus: quick Q — who owns post-deploy verification on region eu-west-1?
priya: that's me, I'll verify EU metrics and surface any region-specific anomalies.
maya: all set from my side. STARTING SLOT 10 at 13:00 UTC unless you hear otherwise. :rocket:
